title: The rescue line
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the outside wall of the weathered stone lighthouse tower on its cliff, with iron rungs, ledges and wet masonry, waves exploding on the rocks far below. Time and weather: night, renewed storm, slate-blue darkness pierced by crimson drone optics and emerald threat light.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks.
Camera: downward shot as the line snaps taut; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Mid-fall the hero fires an orange grapple cable that hooks the tower; it snaps taut and the hero swings to a stop just above the crashing rocks, cable still clutched.
No dialogue.
Sound: cable launch, hook clank, sudden taut twang, crashing waves.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (the masked hero), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: The hero dangles, then starts winching upward.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: cable launch, hook clank, sudden taut twang, crashing waves.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
